verdict.rationale: Shopify Payments is documented as the native, no-third-party-gateway option ('Accept cards, wallets, installments, and crypto—from day one' — shopify-docs-14) and the checkout it powers is highlighted as high-converting (shopify-docs-25/40), but the evidence pack contains no first-party page on published card-processing rates or dedicated fraud-tooling (e.g. Shopify Fraud Filter) documentation. Community reports also surface real friction with the payouts side of the integrated system (random payout freezes over address verification — shopify-comm-4; extra 1% fee if you opt for a 3rd-party gateway instead — shopify-comm-6), which are caveats rather than proof the native processing doesn't work. Missing for 10: explicit published rate-card documentation, dedicated fraud-detection tooling docs, and independent corroboration of payout reliability.
